intro.text: Billboard Boulevard glows at night, but half the signs are blank and the rest are ugly.
Quack. HTML is the structure, CSS is the style. Write both and watch the preview change.

mid.text: The signs look sharp. Now they need to react when passers-by click.
Quack. JavaScript runs in the browser and responds to events. A few quick checks.

outro.text: The boulevard lights up. A page is just text the browser turns into something you can see and touch.
Quack. Next: the Control Tower, where pages come from a server.
